cohort: 500 women at Kamla Raje hospital Gwalior from January 2019 to June 2020
finding: Inadequate or excessive maternal weight gain, as per IOM guidelines, is associated with poor maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: 71% of women with inadequate weight gain had vaginal deliveries, while 78% of women with excessive weight gain had cesarean sections.
birth_weight: low birth weight (in cases of low maternal weight gain), higher birth weight (in cases of high maternal weight gain)
